plain_description: Meshroom turns ordinary 2D photographs into detailed 3D models without writing code. Connect visual nodes to build custom photogrammetry pipelines for product digitization, cultural heritage preservation, or spatial mapping. Pre-built plugins handle camera tracking, HDR fusion, and panorama stitching out of the box.
technical_description: Meshroom is an open-source, node-based visual programming framework for 3D reconstruction and computer vision pipelines. Each node represents a processing operation; output attributes feed into downstream nodes with automatic invalidation and caching of intermediate results upon attribute changes. The Qt/QML-based desktop UI provides a graph editor, attribute inspector, 2D/3D output viewers, and an image gallery. Execution supports both local processing and distributed computation across render farms. The framework is extensible through a Python plugin API; official releases bundle plugins for photogrammetry (AliceVision), semantic segmentation, depth estimation, Gaussian splatting, dense feature matching, and geospatial integration.
title: Meshroom
